mapper.select: SELECT D.PROD_CD , D.LOT_ID , COUNT(*) AS IN_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN C.PASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN1_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN2_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN3_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN4_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN5_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN6_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN7_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN8_QTY , SUM(CASE WHEN D.BIN_NO = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIN9_QTY FROM TB_DEVICE_BIN D LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BIN_CODE C ON C.BIN_NO = D.BIN_NO WHERE D.WORK_DT = #{workDt} AND D.EXCL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY D.PROD_CD, D.LOT_ID ORDER BY D.PROD_CD, D.LOT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LOT_YIELD ( WORK_DT, PROD_CD, LOT_ID, IN_QTY, PASS_QTY, YIELD_PCT, BIN1_QTY, BIN2_QTY, BIN3_QTY, BIN4_QTY, BIN5_QTY, BIN6_QTY, BIN7_QTY, BIN8_QTY, BIN9_QTY, ALERT_YN, REG_DTM ) VALUES ( #{workDt}, #{prodCd}, #{lotId}, #{inQty}, #{passQty}, #{yieldPct}, #{bin1Qty}, #{bin2Qty}, #{bin3Qty}, #{bin4Qty}, #{bin5Qty}, #{bin6Qty}, #{bin7Qty}, #{bin8Qty}, #{bin9Qty}, #{alertYn}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT Y.WORK_DT, Y.PROD_CD, P.PROD_NM, Y.LOT_ID, Y.IN_QTY, Y.PASS_QTY, Y.YIELD_PCT, Y.ALERT_YN FROM TB_LOT_YIELD Y LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PROD_CD = Y.PROD_CD WHERE Y.WORK_DT = #{workDt} ORDER BY Y.PROD_CD, Y.LOT_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LOT_YIELD WHERE WORK_DT = #{workDt}
SELECT NVL(SUM(PASS_QTY), 0) FROM TB_LOT_YIELD WHERE WORK_DT = #{workDt}

SELECT Y.WORK_DT, Y.PROD_CD, P.PROD_NM, Y.LOT_ID, Y.IN_QTY, Y.PASS_QTY, Y.YIELD_PCT, P.ALERT_YIELD FROM TB_LOT_YIELD Y LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PROD_CD = Y.PROD_CD WHERE Y.WORK_DT = #{workDt} AND Y.ALERT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY Y.PROD_CD, Y.LOT_ID
